name: Example: test fixer
goal: Make this repository's test suite pass without weakening a test

members.name: triage
members.prompt: Run this repository's test suite for this goal: $GOAL. Write TRIAGE.md at the top of the repository: every failing test, its cause as far as you can tell, grouped by the production file to change. Commit it on your branch and report done. Fix nothing yourself.

members.name: fixer
members.prompt: Start by merging the triage branch, which holds TRIAGE.md: git merge --no-edit crew/$CONDUCTOR_RUN/triage (your run is in $CONDUCTOR_RUN). Then fix the failures TRIAGE.md lists, for this goal: $GOAL. Change production code before tests; never delete, skip or loosen a test. Commit once per group in TRIAGE.md and report done when the whole suite passes.
